source.snippet: I wish there was a tool to convert csv to Excel. Something like Flatfile but for desktop use.

problem_statement: Users frequently need to convert and clean CSV files into properly formatted Excel workbooks on their desktop, but existing tools either require cloud upload (privacy concern) or are complex enterprise products not suited for ad-hoc desktop use.
target_segment: Data analysts, operations staff, and small business users who work with CSV exports and need Excel-compatible output without cloud dependency
notes: Signal is a single HN comment but the use case is extremely common. Flatfile targets enterprise; a lightweight desktop/offline alternative has clear differentiation potential.
